tests.evidence_tier: isolated actual HostApplication/DataExtension + SQLite/HostResourceStore and LocalStore F9 regression
coverage: Two real queued P2 Steps with same canonical Host workspace, distinct scope paths, current SourcePin and Host graph snapshot
Host prepare delegates to Core F9 union claim and verified per-Step F5 contexts
read_step_batch validates owner, revision, current source, directive hashes, context refs, criteria, scope union and single slot
LocalStore read_step_batch fails closed with host_connection_required
P2 actual handle attachment is reused by the Core F9 binding hook and bind_step_batch accepts no handle input
Owner-published structured result report plus P2 stop receipt is hash-checked, linked to the bound parent run, and collected into two child results
Wrong actor access and a tampered parent report hash are rejected

tests.error: Windows fixture setup failed while persisting its initial evidence resource: SQLite reported 'attempt to write a readonly database'; affected test body did not run
tests.coverage_note: F5 full regression is incomplete; the targeted Host/Local F9 tests above passed.
